scope: Original BF16 layer0 expert0 standalone projections in VRAM; phase-specific kernels; no IQ2/Q2 decode timing, PCIe, actual model activations, SwiGLU, routing or engine integration.

cohorts.rule_before_measurement: A770 phase screen. Original BF16 layer0 expert0 GU1280x2560 and down2560x640. PrefillT8,9,16,40,64,128,256: native BF16 joint_matrix SG8 FP32 baseline versus offline positive radix16 double-U4 weights/two S4 activation residual planes, with every-call activation pack and 4DPAS/group64. Variants combine weight integer terms before scale; NC1/2 output tiles share activation loads. Same-quantized output NRMSE<=2e-6; versus originalBF16 normal<=5%,outlier<=10%; not model quality. DecodeT1,4,6: current native_bf16 FP32-activation GEMV versus SG16 packed128bit-weight/vector8-activation reads, no quantization/DPAS/new weight format, full-output NRMSE<=2e-6. Two profiles seed271027,normal and 1in256 x16 outliers. CPU64 corner reference, full-output,unused/guard checks. 8 equal-content physical VRAM banks; no PCIe/real model activations/SwiGLU/routing/engine integration. Warm64 pairs then 8ABBA cycles,64calls/arm,host wall time,inorder profiling queue. Each cycle both arms endpoint drift<=3%;screen requires6stable and median gain>=3%. Independent process confirmation repeats all cells,including failures. All raw samples retained.
